versions.changelog:
- Added documentation for the MCP `search_listings` endpoint returning a `price_context` block with summary statistics over comparable asking prices.
- Clarified that these price statistics should be quoted as asking prices of similar ads, not as appraised market values.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.
- No changes to API endpoints or core functionality.

- Updated API agent rate limits: free tier now allows 10/day (was 100/day), with higher tiers available by subscription.
- Clarified API agent rate-limiting and added references to upgrading via "Abonnement" or "Plannen".
- Removed outdated documentation file: skill-card.md.
- Minor documentation adjustments to align with new rate limits and subscription options.

- Added "auctim" to the list of supported auction-house sources.
- Minor documentation updates to reflect the expanded source coverage.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Added documentation for MCP (Claude/Cursor/ChatGPT) hosted endpoint with tools and setup link.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.

- Added De Striep Promo ("strieppromo") as a new Belgian second-hand source.
- Updated documentation to include "strieppromo" in the list of searchable sources and examples.
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- General documentation refresh.

- Added support and documentation for the Think Twice (Think2.eu) vintage chain (“thinktwice” source).
- Updated the list of searchable sources and bucket aliases to include Think Twice.
- Updated references and examples to reflect the newly supported source.
- Removed obsolete file: skill-card.md.

- Added new listing type kringloop (for Troc.com and Kringwinkel thrift shops) alongside tweedehands and veiling in both API documentation and usage.
- Updated /v1/search parameter details: listing_type now accepts tweedehands, veiling, and kringloop (can be repeated for multiselect).
- Clarified that source param accepts bucket aliases like kringloop/troc for thrift stores.
- Updated pitfalls section to explain new aliasing and listing_type selection changes.
- Removed file: skill-card.md.

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md and references/api.md for clarity and improved guidance.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- Clarified available endpoints and example usage.
- Adjusted rate limit details and error handling notes for /v1/answer endpoint.
- Streamlined and cleaned up sections to reduce duplication.

- Added Kringwinkel.be as a new supported source (including fixed-price webshop and auction lots).
- Updated documentation to reflect Kringwinkel integration; new `source` option and usage notes.
- Removed outdated file: skill-card.md.

- Increased the default and maximum values for the search result limit (`limit`): now defaults to 24; max 100 for `keyword` search or 50 for `neural`/`auto`.
- Updated search pagination instructions: use the `offset` parameter while `hasMore` is true.
- Documentation improvements reflecting API changes, including limit adjustments.
- Removed redundant documentation file (skill-card.md).

- Documentation updated in SKILL.md and references/api.md to reflect improvements or clarifications.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- No functional or API changes; this is a documentation cleanup release.

- Added support for Belgian car dealer sources (e.g. autoscout24.be, gocar.be, mazdastock.be, vroom.be, autohero.com, irisautocenter.be, autocadre.com) as searchable domains.
- Updated documentation to reflect new data sources and clarify car-dealer source usage.
- Removed outdated references to troc.com being paused.
- Cleaned up and clarified instructions for using the API.
- Removed deprecated file: skill-card.md.

- Updated user ad URL format: own ads now live at koopje.ai/<category>/<slug>-<id> instead of koopje.ai/l/<id>.
- Documentation improvements to reflect new ad URL structure.
- Removed obsolete documentation file: skill-card.md.

- Added support and documentation for new own-ad endpoints: creating drafts (`POST /v1/listings/draft`) and publishing drafts (`POST /v1/listings/publish`).
- Updated references to list the new endpoints for handling unindexed user listing drafts.
- Removed the deprecated file `skill-card.md`.
- Minor documentation clarifications and consistency fixes.

- Added support for user-submitted own ads as a new source (`user`) in the koopje.ai search API.
- Updated documentation to include endpoints and usage for creating, renewing, and managing user listings.
- Removed outdated file: skill-card.md.

- Expanded to 155k+ listings, now aggregating six sources (added Zoekertjes.be and individual auction-house slugs).
- Introduced `listing_type` (binary: "tweedehands" or "veiling") for clearer filtering, independent of source.
- Updated supported sources and parameter options, including more granular control over `source`.
- Added agent endpoint (`POST /v1/agent`) and saved listings endpoints.
- Clarified API limits, error reporting, latest pitfalls, and new features in documentation.
- Removed outdated references and simplified instructions.
v1.0.3: offset pagination, _price_kind, distance/userLocation envelope, /v1/me usage
v1.0.2: distance filter params (postcode/max_km), auction-house naming
v1.0.1: name the actual auction houses (Vavato, Troostwijk, Belga-Veilingen, …) in results instead of only alleveilingen
Initial release: search 2dehands, Troc.com, Marktplaats BE listings and alleveilingen.be auctions
